ambiguous_behavior: if more than one supported card-level oracle_id remains, emit ORACLE_SEMANTIC_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED and do not guess
candidate_filter: provider records with NON_DECK_PROVIDER_LAYOUTS, NON_DECK_PROVIDER_SET_TYPES, or commander legality other than legal are excluded from semantic candidate uniqueness; their provider record ids remain in evidence
candidate_precedence: exact top-level provider card-name match takes precedence over face-name aliases; face aliases are fallback candidates only when no top-level record exists for the requested name
face_oracle_identity: optional source-provided face oracle_id preserved separately; never combined into a synthetic identity
printing_identity: only populated when the deck source row explicitly supplies set and collector number; name-only or set-only rows never receive a selected printing id
